dev.title: Development scenario
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics and logs
diagnostics.hint: Logs stay on this device. Reproduce the issue, then save the file to share it with the developer. Tokens and signed link parameters are redacted.
profile.title: Interface recording
profile.hint: Tap Start, use the app as usual (tabs, player, tracks, lyrics), then tap Stop in the pill at the top and export the log. It contains the response time of every tap, frame smoothness, long tasks, memory and load times of tracks, lyrics and waveforms.
profile.saved: Recording saved: p95 {p95} ms, {janky} janky frames
trace.title: Trace
trace.hint: For bugs that show only on some tracks. Turn on what you need, play a track where it happens, wait for the jerk (or switch a few tracks) and save the log. Each track gets a summary, and each jerk its own entry with the cause: a player clock jump, a long frame or the animation itself.
